records.label: Template Identity / Category / Lifecycle / Revision
records.notes: Reusable/event-specific email templates and revision/history concepts are market parity.

records.label: Subject / Preheader / Locale / HTML-Plaintext Mode
records.notes: Subject/message/type metadata are parity; locale/plaintext fallback details remain explicit WPE policy.

records.label: Bounded Repeater / Legal / Dynamic / Conditional Blocks
records.notes: Dynamic/conditional/reusable blocks are parity but execute only through bounded registered providers/tokens.

records.label: Typed Token Schema / Null Fallback
records.notes: Dynamic shortcodes/data are parity; WPE normalizes typed allowlisted tokens and predictable null fallback.

records.label: Locale Fallback / Plaintext Generation & Override
records.notes: Provider behavior varies; deterministic locale fallback and plaintext generation remain explicit WPE renderer policy.

records.label: Reviewed WordPress Event Adapter Reference
records.notes: Reviewed event-specific template adapters are established compatibility behavior.

records.label: Certified Third-Party Adapter
records.notes: Broad third-party email integrations are market parity but each adapter remains separately certified.

records.label: Sender Profile Reference
records.notes: Sender metadata is common; credentials and verification remain transport/Vault-owned.

records.label: Attachment References / Count / Size / MIME Policy
records.notes: Transport can attach files, but protected-resource authorization and count/size/MIME policy remain explicit WPE safety rules.

records.label: Preview / Test / Preflight Diagnostics
records.notes: Preview/test flows are market parity; preview must not silently become uncontrolled external delivery.

records.label: Secret-Free Import/Export / Revision Compile Cache
records.notes: Transfer/backup/history are market-evidenced; secret exclusion, conflict handling and compile-cache behavior remain explicit WPE contracts.

records.label: Raw PHP / Script / Untrusted HTML
records.notes: Market HTML/customizer flexibility does not justify arbitrary PHP/script or untrusted executable markup.

coverage.notes: All Email records are native/market classified. Templates/layout/blocks/tokens/overrides/preview are parity; sender is provider-bound, locale/plaintext/attachments/portability remain WPE hardening, and raw executable content stays rejected.
